title: Private Home in Smyrna
description:
Enjoy a fully fenced backyard—perfect for dogs (pet fee applies)—plus a covered patio for parking. This 2-bedroom home features a king in the master and a double + twin in the second bedroom. Fully stocked kitchen, free WiFi, and TVs in the living room and both bedrooms. Lots of amenities for a comfortable stay!

The space
Welcome to our charming, newly renovated home located in Smyrna, offering convenient access to I-24, Nissan, Taylor Farms, and Nashville. 

Bedrooms: This unit features 2 bedrooms, making it ideal for families or small groups. The master bedroom boasts a comfortable king-size bed, while the second bedroom offers one cozy double bed and one twin bed.

Bathroom: You'll find a full bathroom in this unit, complete with all the essentials you need for a refreshing shower or bath. 

Kitchen: Our kitchen is fully stocked with a variety of spices and includes a convenient Keurig coffee maker. Whether you're cooking up a meal or brewing your morning coffee, you'll find everything you need at your fingertips.

Guest access
This a private home and you will have access to the entire place.
